verdict.rationale: Evidence covers order/checkout/sale events, webhooks, chargebacks, device profiling and API sensitive-data rejection, but nothing in the pack references allow/block lists for emails, cards, devices, or IPs, nor velocity limits, nor a dashboard/API mechanism to manage them. missing for 10: allow/block list management (email/card/device/IP), velocity limit configuration, dashboard UI for rules, API endpoints for list/rule management.
